description: Get the next upcoming event on a tour — e.g. "what's the next show". Optionally filter to one event type (show, travel, day_off, load_in, sound_check, rehearsal, meeting, other) and/or return more than one upcoming event.

eventType.description: Restrict to one event type, e.g. "show".

fromDate.description: Only consider events on or after this date. Defaults to today.

limit.description: How many upcoming events to return (default 1).

name: get_next_event
title: Get next event
